what.text: This page follows refugees from the Republic of the Congo in all host countries combined, as counted by UNHCR at the end of each year.
At the end of 2025, UNHCR counted 13134 refugees from the Republic of the Congo.
France hosts the largest share, 50.5%, followed by South Africa, the United States and Canada.

why.text: UCDP records armed conflict over the government of Congo in 1993, from 1997 to 1999, in 2002 and in 2016, with the Ntsiloulous in 2002 and 2016.
The main years of displacement in the data, 1997 to 2010 and 2014 to 2015, begin in the years of that conflict.

when.text: UNHCR's series starts in 1967 at 930 refugees.
The figure was at its highest, 28950, at the end of 2003, and was lower by the end of 2025.

how.text: The sources don't say which routes people took.
These are year-end totals summed over every host country, reported to UNHCR.
